home.heroTitle: Isoko yizewe y'ubugeni buva mu turere dukeneye kugaragara.
home.heroBody: Abaguzi bagendera mu imurikagurisha ry'ikoranabuhanga ryakozwe n'abatezimbere ubugeni, bareba uko ubuhanzi bwakwiyoroshya mu nzu yabo bakoresheje AR, kandi bakagura bafite ikizere. Abahanzi bagera ku bakiriya ku isi hose bakishyurwa mu buryo bwizewe.
